segments.text:
V. 35.
Your houſe is left to you deſolate—Is now irrevocably conſigned to Deſolation and Deſtruction: And verily I ſay to you, after a very ſhort Space, ye ſhall not ſee me till the time come, when taught by your Calamities, ye ſhall be ready and diſpoſed to ſay, Bleſſed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord. It does not imply, that they ſhould then ſee Jeſus at all; but only, that they would earneſtly wiſh for the Meſſiah, and in their Extremity be ready to entertain any who ſhould aſſume that Character.
